AnalysisMode: read-only; opens PRSEG files FileAccess.Read and writes only OutputPath outside the index

Candidates.Name: current-prefix10
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix table + binary search over fixed 10-byte records
Candidates.Note: Current PRSEG005 representation: suffix u16 + packed(count,encoding) u32 + payload offset u32.

Candidates.Name: fixed8-packed14
Candidates.LookupModel: same prefix partition; O(1) fixed-record addressing and binary search
Candidates.Note: Uses suffix u16 + packed14(count)+2-bit encoding in u16 + offset u32. Applicable only if every count <= 16383.

Candidates.Name: fixed-minimal-byte-fields
Candidates.LookupModel: same prefix partition; fixed-width records, but segment-specific nonstandard field widths
Candidates.Note: Theoretical byte-aligned lower bound using the minimum whole-byte width required by each segment's max count and max absolute offset.

Candidates.Name: fixed-bit-packed
Candidates.LookupModel: same prefix partition; bit-addressable fixed records
Candidates.Note: Theoretical bit-packed fixed-width lower bound using segment-specific packed-count and absolute-offset bit widths. Random lookup remains indexable but decode complexity increases.

Candidates.Name: prefix-delta-varint-stream
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix selects byte range, then sequential varint decode within prefix
Candidates.Note: Suffix gap, packed(count+encoding), and payload-offset delta use unsigned varints. First suffix/offset in each prefix are absolute.

Candidates.Name: blocked-delta-16
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix -> binary-search 10-byte block checkpoints -> decode at most 16 records
Candidates.Note: Each block checkpoint stores firstSuffix u16, streamOffset u32, basePayloadOffset u32; records use varint deltas.

Candidates.Name: blocked-delta-32
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix -> binary-search 10-byte block checkpoints -> decode at most 32 records
Candidates.Note: Each block checkpoint stores firstSuffix u16, streamOffset u32, basePayloadOffset u32; records use varint deltas.

Candidates.Name: blocked-delta-64
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix -> binary-search 10-byte block checkpoints -> decode at most 64 records
Candidates.Note: Each block checkpoint stores firstSuffix u16, streamOffset u32, basePayloadOffset u32; records use varint deltas.

Candidates.Name: blocked-delta-128
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix -> binary-search 10-byte block checkpoints -> decode at most 128 records
Candidates.Note: Each block checkpoint stores firstSuffix u16, streamOffset u32, basePayloadOffset u32; records use varint deltas.

Candidates.Name: blocked-delta-256
Candidates.LookupModel: prefix -> binary-search 10-byte block checkpoints -> decode at most 256 records
Candidates.Note: Each block checkpoint stores firstSuffix u16, streamOffset u32, basePayloadOffset u32; records use varint deltas.

Candidates.Name: bitmap-rank-u32-values
Candidates.LookupModel: 24-bit presence bitmap + rank512 + direct packed u32/offset u32 value arrays
Candidates.Note: Per segment: 2 MiB key bitmap + 32-bit rank checkpoint every 512 keys + 8 bytes per present key.

Candidates.Name: bitmap-rank-packed14
Candidates.LookupModel: 24-bit presence bitmap + rank512 + direct packed u16/offset u32 value arrays
Candidates.Note: Per segment: 2 MiB key bitmap + rank checkpoints + 6 bytes per present key. Requires all counts <= 16383.

Candidates.Name: bitmap-rank-bit-packed-values
Candidates.LookupModel: 24-bit presence bitmap + rank512 + segment-specific bit-packed values
Candidates.Note: Theoretical compact random-lookup model: bitmap/rank locates ordinal; packed count+encoding and absolute offset use minimum segment-specific bit widths.

Caveats: This tool estimates directory representation size only. It does not modify CQ3DIR/CQ3POST or benchmark search latency.
Theoretical compact formats are not format-compatible with PRSEG005; they are sizing models for a future format study.
Variable-length models trade random-access simplicity for decode work; size alone is not an ACCEPT criterion.
The analyzer validates magic/version/section descriptors/prefix shape/order/offset monotonicity but intentionally does not recompute full PRSEG checksums.
